narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to our quiz section, "Test Your Knowledge: Control and Coordination." This is your chance to assess your understanding of the nervous and endocrine systems, and plant coordination. Let's dive right in with our first question. What is the function of receptors in our body? Think of situations where receptors do not work properly. What problems are likely to arise? Take a moment to think about it. All information from the environment is detected by receptors. If they don't work properly, information can't be detected, and our body can't respond accordingly. Next question! Draw the structure of a neuron and explain its function. How does information travel through it? The information is acquired at the dendrite tip of a nerve cell. It then travels as an electrical impulse from the dendrite to the cell body, and then along the axon to its end. Moving on, how does phototropism occur in plants? This question is about plant hormones. Plant hormones, or phytohormones, are chemical compounds released by stimulated cells for control and coordination. Auxin controls growth, Gibberellins help in stem growth, Cytokinin promotes cell division, and Abscisic acid inhibits growth. Now for our final question: Which signals will get disrupted in case of a spinal cord injury? Consider the role of the spinal cord. In case of a spinal cord injury, signals for reflex action and involuntary action will get disrupted. Reflex actions are monitored and controlled through the spinal cord, not directly by the brain. An injury here disrupts all signals to and from the nerves. Great job, everyone! I hope this quiz helped reinforce your understanding of control and coordination. Keep practicing and learning!

visual_beats.description: Quiz Section Title: Test Your Knowledge: Control and Coordination
Learning Objectives: Assess understanding of nervous and endocrine systems, and plant coordination.
Question: What is the function of receptors in our body? Think of situations where receptors do not work properly. What problems are likely to arise?
Answer: All information from environment is detected by receptors. When receptors do not work properly then information from environment cannot be detected and our body cannot respond accordingly.
Question: Draw the structure of neuron and explain its function.

Answer: (i) The information is acquired at the end of the dendrite tip of a nerve cell (ii) The information travels as an electrical impulse from the dendrite to the cell body and then along the axon to its end.
Question: How does phototropism occur in plants?

Answer: The chemical compounds released by stimulated cells for control and coordination in plants are called plant hormones or phytohormones. Auxin: Controls growth; Gibberellins: Helps in growth of stem; Cytokinin: Promotes cell division; Abscisic acid: Inhibits growth, wilting of leaves.
Question: Which signals will get disrupted in case of spinal cord injury?

Answer: In case of a spinal cord injury, signals for reflex action and involuntary action will get disrupted. Reflex actions are monitored and controlled through the spinal cord of nervous system and not by the brain. In fact, nerves from all over the body meet in a bundle in the spinal cord on their way to the brain. In case of any injury to the spinal cord, the signals coming from the nerves as well as signals coming to the receptors will be disrupted.
